title: Not great and Not bad
text: Not great and Not bad. We ordered this for our leather sofa, since it was light grey and my kid always jumps, writes something with pens. So we ordered this to give a try, but it didn't fit well and it is pretty hard to stick it to the sofa, mya be a wrong choice for leather sofas. The material is thick enough and water drops proof too. But looks wise it is okay, so may be a good fit for homes with Pets..
